title: Sport
summary: Talk about sport, give orders on the pitch to one person or a group, and say what you like doing with أُحِبُّ أَنْ…
intro: Daniel is well again, and on Saturday he plays football with Omar and Sami. On the pitch people give a lot of orders. Remember the endings: to a man اِلْعَبْ (play!), to a woman اِلْعَبِي, and to a group اِلْعَبُوا. Don't forget the negative: لَا تَرْكُضْ (don't run!). To say what you like doing, use أُحِبُّ أَنْ + a verb ending in -a: أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَلْعَبَ (I like to play).
objectives: Name five sports and say which one you like
Give orders to one person and to a group on the pitch
Say what you like doing with أُحِبُّ أَنْ…
Use the words for team, ball, goal and pitch

realLife.title: Saturday on the pitch
realLife.story: The club pitch is full of children on Saturday morning. Daniel plays in goal so that he doesn't have to run much. Omar scores in the first minute, Sami talks about swimming, and Daniel decides that sport is the best medicine.

sentences.literal: I love that I play (the) ball (of) the foot

mistakes.why: After an the verb ends in -a, not -u: an alʿaba.
An order to a group ends in -ū: ilʿabū. ilʿab is for one man.

sentences.en: Don't run too much. (to a man)

sentences.ar: يَجِبُ أَنْ أَمْشِيَ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْكُضَ.
sentences.en: I must walk before I run.
sentences.literal: it is necessary that I walk before that I run

dialogue.title: Football on Saturday
dialogue.culture: Football is by far the most popular sport in Egypt, and the big Cairo clubs, Al Ahly and Zamalek, have millions of fans. Many people also belong to a sports club, النَّادِي, with a pool and pitches, where families spend the weekend.

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر يَا دَانْيَال! أَنْتَ هُنَا فِي الْمَلْعَب! هَلْ أَنْتَ جَاهِز لِلْمُبَارَاة؟
lines.en: Good morning, Daniel! You're here at the pitch! Are you ready for the match?

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور يَا بَطَل! أَنَا جَاهِز، لٰكِنِّي سَأَلْعَبُ قَلِيلًا فَقَطْ، كَمَا قَالَتِ الطَّبِيبَة.
lines.en: Good morning, champ! I'm ready, but I'll only play a little, as the doctor said.

lines.ar: هَيَّا! الْفَرِيقُ الْأَوَّل: أَنَا وَعُمَر. وَأَنْتَ يَا دَانْيَال حَارِسُ الْمَرْمَى!
lines.en: Come on! Team one is Omar and me. And you, Daniel, are the goalkeeper!

lines.ar: فِكْرَة ذَكِيَّة! الْحَارِس لَا يَرْكُضُ كَثِيرًا. لٰكِنْ فِي شِيكَاغُو أَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ السَّلَّة، لَا كُرَةَ الْقَدَم.
lines.en: A clever idea! The goalkeeper doesn't run much. But in Chicago I play basketball, not football.

lines.ar: كُرَةُ السَّلَّة؟ أَنَا أُحِبُّ كُرَةَ الْقَدَم أَكْثَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ الرِّيَاضَات!
lines.en: Basketball? I love football more than any other sport!

lines.ar: عُمَر يَلْعَبُ فِي فَرِيقِ الْمَدْرَسَة، وَهُوَ يَتَدَرَّبُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّات فِي الْأُسْبُوع.
lines.en: Omar plays in the school team, and he trains three times a week.

lines.ar: اِنْتَبِهْ يَا دَانْيَال! الْكُرَة قَادِمَة إِلَيْكَ… سَأُسَجِّلُ هَدَفًا!
lines.en: Watch out, Daniel! The ball is coming your way… I'm going to score a goal!

lines.ar: لَا تُسَجِّلْ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ!… هَدَف! أَنْتَ سَرِيع جِدًّا يَا عُمَر.
lines.en: Don't score, please!… Goal! You are very fast, Omar.

lines.ar: أَحْسَنْتَ يَا عُمَر! وَالْآنَ يَا دَانْيَال، اِرْتَحْ قَلِيلًا وَاشْرَبْ مَاءً. لَا تَرْكُضْ كَثِيرًا.
lines.en: Well done, Omar! And now, Daniel, rest a little and drink some water. Don't run too much.

lines.ar: أَنَا أُحِبُّ الرِّيَاضَة، لٰكِنْ يَجِبُ أَنْ أَمْشِيَ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْكُضَ! وَأَنْتَ يَا سَامِي، أَيَّ رِيَاضَة تُحِبُّ؟
lines.en: I love sport, but I must walk before I run! And you, Sami, which sport do you like?

lines.ar: أَنَا أُحِبُّ السِّبَاحَة أَكْثَرَ مِنْ كُرَةِ الْقَدَم. أَسْبَحُ فِي النَّادِي كُلَّ يَوْمِ ثُلَاثَاء.
lines.en: I like swimming more than football. I swim at the club every Tuesday.

lines.ar: رَائِع! بَعْدَ أُسْبُوع أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْبَحَ مَعَكَ، إِذَا قَالَتِ الطَّبِيبَة نَعَم.
lines.en: Great! In a week I want to swim with you, if the doctor says yes.

lines.ar: وَالْآنَ تَعَالَ يَا دَانْيَال! اِلْعَبْ مَعَنَا خَمْسَ دَقَائِق فَقَطْ، لَا أَكْثَر!
lines.en: And now come on, Daniel! Play with us for just five minutes, no more!

lines.ar: اِلْعَبَا أَنْتُمَا، وَأَنَا الْحَكَم الْآنَ. هَيَّا، الْمُبَارَاة تَبْدَأُ مِنْ جَدِيد!
lines.en: You two play, and I'm the referee now. Come on, the match starts again!

lines.ar: يَا سَلَام! أَشْعُرُ أَنَّنِي بِصِحَّة جَيِّدَة الْآنَ. الرِّيَاضَة أَحْسَن دَوَاء!
lines.en: Wonderful! I feel that I'm in good health now. Sport is the best medicine!

reading.title: A match at the club
reading.ar: يَوْمَ السَّبْت لَعِبَ دَانْيَال كُرَةَ الْقَدَم مَعَ عُمَر وَسَامِي فِي مَلْعَبِ النَّادِي. كَانَ دَانْيَال حَارِسَ الْمَرْمَى، وَسَجَّلَ عُمَر هَدَفًا. عُمَر يُحِبُّ كُرَةَ الْقَدَم، وَسَامِي يُحِبُّ السِّبَاحَة. الْآنَ دَانْيَال بِصِحَّة جَيِّدَة.
reading.en: On Saturday Daniel played football with Omar and Sami on the club pitch. Daniel was the goalkeeper, and Omar scored a goal. Omar loves football, and Sami loves swimming. Now Daniel is in good health.

quiz.prompt: Which sport does Sami like most?
What does Daniel play in Chicago?
Which word has qāf (ق), the deep k said at the back of the throat?

completion: Fantastic! You finished Week 7: you can talk about the body, health, feelings and sport, give orders and advice. Take the week test, and pass it with 80% to open Week 8.
